description:
Paircast is an invite-only private cloud player for synchronized playback. Videos come from the private library your self-hosted server connects to your own storage. There is no public catalog, and the app does not distribute films or TV shows.

Synced playback
Create a room and share an invite link. After friends join, play, pause, and playback position stay in sync among invited members. Friends on iPhone, iPad, and Android can share the same room.

Chat while you watch
Send text messages and stickers in the room. Touch and hold a message to block the sender or file a report. Chat is visible only to invited members.

Subtitles
Load embedded subtitles from the video, sidecar files stored next to the movie, or online subtitle search when your server enables it. Subtitles the host shares load automatically for members who join later.

Your server and account
You only enter the address of your self-hosted server. Its admin sets up the media library. Accounts are created by the server admin; there is no sign-up in the app. Your session token stays in the on-device Keychain. You can delete your account from the Me screen.

Paircast is for friends who already have lawful private media and want to watch together from a distance.
promotionalText: Connect to your own server to watch in sync with invited friends, and chat while you watch.
whatsNew:
Paircast 2.0 moves to a self-hosted server.
- Service Configuration only needs the server address; the library, subtitles, posters, and stickers come from the server, with no storage keys or third-party tokens in the app
- Sign in with the account and password your admin gives you, and change your password from Me; there is no sign-up in the app
- Now on Android: watch together with friends who use Android
- Switch sources in the Library when the server has more than one; members who join later automatically load subtitles the host shared
- New Admin Console: admins add, disable, or delete accounts and review chat reports
- Delete Account now deletes the account on the server; your chat block list follows your account
- You agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before signing in
- Old configuration links and config sharing are no longer supported
